changes.description: Add dependency @fontsource-variable/inter (^5.2.0, latest 5.x at install time; OFL, maintained) via `npm install -w @bob-pipeline/web @fontsource-variable/inter` run from tools/bob-pipeline/.
Regenerated by the install; must only add @fontsource-variable/inter and the workspace dependency entry. Review the diff for unrelated churn.
Change <body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 antialiased"> to <body>; colour, font and antialiasing move to index.css base styles.

Remove the :root font-family. Add an @theme token block (--font-sans Inter Variable + system fallback; --color-brand-50..900 teal scale with 700+ for white-text fills; neutral tokens canvas #f9fafb, surface #fff, subtle #f3f4f6, line #e5e7eb, line-strong #d1d5db, ink #111827, muted #4b5563; console tokens code/code-bar/code-ink/code-muted; --radius-control/card; --shadow-card/pop). Add @layer base rules: body background/colour/font/antialiasing, a global :focus-visible 2px brand-600 outline with 2px offset for a/button/input/textarea/select/summary, and .prose link colour variable. Keep .prose table rule.
Add `import "@fontsource-variable/inter";` before `import "./index.css";` so Vite bundles the self-hosted woff2 files (served by existing @fastify/static); no CDN request.

Restyle primitives with token classes. Button: rounded-control, shadow-sm, variants default (border-line-strong bg-surface), primary (bg-brand-700 hover:bg-brand-800 text-white), danger (red-300 border, red-700 text), ghost (text-muted hover:bg-subtle); API unchanged; focus via global rule. statusStyle: keep eight keys/labels/hues and animate-pulse on running, neutral ones use gray (not-started bg-gray-100 text-gray-700, parked bg-gray-200 text-gray-700). StatusBadge: rounded-control font-medium. Card: rounded-card border-line bg-surface shadow-card. ErrorBox: rounded-control with red-200/50/800.

Restyle shell: sticky header (bg-surface border-b border-line shadow-card), px-4 sm:px-6 containers, logo text-ink font-semibold; NavLink active bg-brand-50 text-brand-700 font-medium, inactive text-muted hover:bg-subtle hover:text-ink; info/poller text-muted, poll error text-red-700; poller area becomes flex-wrap with gap-x-3 gap-y-2 for tablet/mobile; checkbox accent-brand-700; warning banner stays amber (border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900). Classes only; no JSX/logic change.

Move console colours to tokens: kindCls bob text-code-ink, step text-sky-300, info text-brand-300, error text-red-300; border-code-bar rounded-control; title bar bg-code-bar text-code-ink; body bg-code; loading/empty/timestamp text-code-muted (fixes slate-500 contrast on dark); follow checkbox accent-brand-500.

Add unexported module constant GRAPH_COLORS (comment: mirrors index.css tokens) and use it in edgeStyle and node styles. Edge strokes: overlaps #6b7280 dotted, recorded #0f766e solid, deps-check #c2410c dashed, plan #4f46e5 dashed; labels and return shape unchanged. Focus node border 2px solid #0f766e; plan borders #d1d5db; done background #f3f4f6; edge labelStyle fill #4b5563; Background color #e5e7eb. Container rounded-card border-line bg-surface; text-slate-* classes become text-muted.

Class sweep: text-slate-500/600 to text-muted, error text-red-700, table wrapper rounded-control border-line bg-surface, thead bg-canvas text-muted, tbody divide-line, IssueLink text-brand-700; '✓ on GitHub' stays emerald-700 (success semantic). Relationship dot continues to use edgeStyle().stroke.

Restyle board: filter pills (active border-brand-700 bg-brand-700 text-white; inactive border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink hover:bg-subtle; keep attention font-semibold logic); Column rounded-card border border-line bg-subtle with bordered surface index bubble and text-muted subtitle/empty text; IssueCard Link gets className 'block rounded-card' and Card hover:border-brand-500 hover:shadow-pop; idle Card toggle hover:bg-canvas, dividers border-line, error text-red-700; parked links text-brand-700. Grid template and overflowX unchanged.

Replace slate text with text-muted (including #number prefix, which previously failed contrast); h1 font-semibold tracking-tight; links text-brand-700; blocked-by closed pill bg-subtle text-muted; Stepper done brand-50/200/800, current bg-brand-700 text-white, pending border-line bg-surface text-muted, selected ring-2 ring-brand-500 ring-offset-1, separator text-line-strong; ActionPanel review border-brand-300 (was indigo), textarea rounded-control border-line-strong bg-surface, messages bg-canvas text-ink, checkbox accent-brand-700; Runs dot cancelled bg-gray-400; comment border-line.

Class sweep: loading/meta text-muted, h1 font-semibold tracking-tight, checkbox accent-brand-700, cycles/conflicts boxes keep red/amber semantics with rounded-control (reporter note amber-800), suggested-order index text-muted, order links text-brand-700 (cycle members stay red-700).

Class sweep: slate text to text-muted; schema valid text-emerald-700 (was 600, failed contrast), errors text-red-700; JSON/raw pre bg-code text-code-ink rounded-control; RevisionDiff/UnifiedDiff containers border-line bg-surface rounded-control with context lines text-muted and diff header bg-subtle text-ink (add/remove/hunk semantic colours kept); markdown prose-slate becomes prose-gray.
Class sweep: text-slate-500 to text-muted, 'All issues' link text-brand-700, error text-red-700.

META colours darkened for 4.5:1 white-on-fill and kept distinct by hue: smoke #c2410c/text-orange-700, bdd #6d28d9/text-violet-700, component #1d4ed8/text-blue-700, unit #0f766e/text-brand-700 (literal class strings). Tab buttons active bg-brand-700 text-white, inactive bg-subtle text-ink; tables/cards border-line rounded-control, thead bg-canvas text-muted, divide-line; gherkin and gaps panels bg-canvas; trace chips bg-subtle text-ink; slate text to text-muted.

interfaces.name: Button
interfaces.notes: Props unchanged; only the class strings per variant change. StatusBadge, Card and ErrorBox props are also unchanged.

interfaces.name: edgeStyle
interfaces.signature: edgeStyle(e: Pick<DependencyEdge, "kind" | "source" | "recorded">): { stroke: string; strokeDasharray: string | undefined; label: string }
interfaces.notes: Signature and labels unchanged; only returned stroke hex values change. Consumed by DepGraph, GraphLegend and DependencyTable.

interfaces.name: Design tokens (CSS-only)
interfaces.signature: Tailwind classes generated from @theme in index.css: bg|text|border-brand-{50..900}, bg-canvas|surface|subtle|code|code-bar, border-line|line-strong, text-ink|muted|code-ink|code-muted, rounded-control|card, shadow-card|pop, font-sans
interfaces.notes: New styling API consumed by components; no runtime/TypeScript surface.

data_changes: New npm dependency @fontsource-variable/inter in tools/bob-pipeline/apps/web/package.json with matching tools/bob-pipeline/package-lock.json update; run the repo dependency/vulnerability scan on it (OFL-1.1).
No env vars, feature flags, schema, migrations or API changes.

test_approach.what: From tools/bob-pipeline run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build -w @bob-pipeline/web`; both must pass with no new warnings. Confirm dist contains Inter .woff2 assets and that built output has no external font URL (grep -r "googleapis\|gstatic" apps/web/dist returns nothing).

Grep sweeps in apps/web/src: remaining slate-/emerald-600|700/indigo- only in the documented semantic exceptions; hex colours only in DepGraph.tsx (GRAPH_COLORS and node styles) and TestPyramidView.tsx (META); no `outline-none` anywhere.

Visual review in `npm run dev` of Button (4 variants x normal/hover/disabled/keyboard-focus), StatusBadge for all eight statuses, Card and ErrorBox; confirm the 2px brand focus ring is visible on each, on IssueCard links, nav links and the textarea.
Visual review of the shell: header surface/border/shadow, sticky behaviour, active vs inactive nav on / and /dependencies, poller controls, and the pipeline.yaml warning banner.

Manual walkthrough recorded in the PR: Given the dashboard is running, when I open Board, an Issue page (review/failed/running/not-started where available) and Dependencies, then all share Inter, teal accent, neutral surfaces and card style with no emerald/slate chrome on primary actions or surfaces; exercise filter pills, stage tabs, approve, record dependency and start pipeline once each to confirm no behaviour regression.

Check /dependencies graph: recorded (solid teal), deps-check (dashed orange), plan (dashed indigo) and overlaps (dotted gray) edges are distinguishable and match GraphLegend; check test-plan stage: four layer colours, band labels and coverage chips are legible and distinct.

Contrast verification: compute WCAG ratios with a contrast checker for every new foreground/background pair (eight badges, button fills, muted text on canvas/subtle/surface, log text on code, pyramid white-on-band fills) and record in the PR; each must be >= 4.5:1.

Responsive review at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390 px: no page-level horizontal scroll other than the existing board grid scroll; header and poller controls wrap; tables and pre blocks scroll within their own containers.

rollout: Single PR, no flags or migrations, revertible by reverting the commit. Order with typecheck and visual check after each step: (1) dependency, main.tsx import, index.css tokens/base rules, index.html body cleanup; (2) ui.tsx primitives; (3) Layout.tsx; (4) Dashboard, then IssuePage with LogView and views/base, then DependenciesPage with DependencyTable, DepGraph and DependencyView, then TestPyramidView; (5) grep sweeps, build, contrast and responsive checks. Per deps.md, #6 should merge after #8 so it copies the restyled primitives; both touch apps/web/package.json and package-lock.json so the second to merge resolves a trivial lockfile conflict.
